queries.name: roster
queries.query: MATCH (n) WHERE n:Person OR n:System OR n:Decision RETURN labels(n)[0], coalesce(n.name, n.title), n.id

queries.name: decisions_by_system
queries.query: MATCH (d:Decision)-[r_sys:about_system]->(s:System) WHERE s.name IN $system_names OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[r_dec:decided_by]->(p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[r_tic:based_on]->(t:Ticket) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[r_mtg:based_on]->(m:Meeting) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[r_sup:supersedes]->(d_sup:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (d_sup_by:Decision)-[r_supby:supersedes]->(d) OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[r_con:contradicts]-(d_con:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[r_own:owns]-(owner:Person) RETURN d.id, d.title, coalesce(d.summary, ''), coalesce(d.rationale, ''), coalesce(d.status, 'accepted'), p.name, s.name, t.ticket_id, t.title, m.title, m.date, d_sup.id, d_sup.title, d_sup_by.id, d_sup_by.title, d_con.id, d_con.title, owner.name, coalesce(owner.is_active, true), coalesce(owner.leave_date, '')

queries.name: system_owners
queries.query: MATCH (s:System) WHERE s.name IN $system_names OPTIONAL MATCH (s)<-[r:owns]-(p:Person) RETURN s.name, p.name, coalesce(p.is_active, true), coalesce(p.leave_date, '')
